_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Device Studio are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `template-manager generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

photographic_scene.title: Generate a photographic scene
photographic_scene.description: Create one local background image for use as a photographic still source.
photographic_scene.disclosure: Your prompt is sent to this device’s local Image Tools service and may be retained with its job. This uses the installed SD 1.5 model only: no hosted fallback, paid call, or account is used. Generation can take several minutes and has a 30-minute execution limit after it starts (queue wait is separate). The image is an editable visual reference; it does not calibrate pixels or device geometry. Adjust the screen quad and masks in the shot tools.
